body:
Reopening: PR #115 delivered the Chromium- and Firefox-family sources, default-browser resolution and source discovery, and its description lists the rest as follow-ups. No follow-up issue was opened, so tracking stays here. Still open, per #115:

- **Safari / Safari Technology Preview** as a source (`.binarycookies`, `Bookmarks.plist`, `History.db`, "Export Passwords" CSV). Safari is the default browser on the machine this was requested from, so `default` resolves to a browser that cannot be imported yet.
- **Import targets other than Chromium**: a controlled Firefox and Playwright WebKit, plus a same-engine full-clone mode. The request is import from *every* browser into *any selected* browser.
- **New data classes**: localStorage, IndexedDB, sessionStorage, autofill, search engines, site settings, sessions, downloads, reading list, client certificates; passkeys reported as skipped with the reason.
- **Clear errors** for macOS Full Disk Access (`EPERM`) and locked profiles.
- **Parity**: the same in Rust and Python, and the source x target x data-class matrix in the README, checked in CI.

Close this only when all of the above have shipped, or split them into linked issues first.
